parameters.content:
## 📈 Dashboard web
Ouvre **http://localhost:5678/webhook/jobhunter?token=TON_TOKEN** (ou `/dashboard` dans Telegram).
Page HTML générée à la volée depuis PostgreSQL : KPIs, funnel, activité sur 14 jours, pipeline façon kanban, meilleures offres, compétences à renforcer, santé des sources et erreurs récentes.
🔒 Protégé par le token `DASHBOARD_TOKEN` du fichier `.env`.

parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT full_name FROM profile WHERE id = 1) AS full_name,
  (SELECT alert_threshold FROM profile WHERE id = 1) AS threshold,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs)::int AS total_jobs,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE collected_at > now() - interval '24 hours')::int AS jobs_24h,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE scored_at IS NULL)::int AS pending,
  (SELECT round(avg(score)) FROM jobs WHERE score IS NOT NULL)::int AS avg_score,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE score >= (SELECT alert_threshold FROM profile WHERE id = 1))::int AS top_matches,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM applications)::int AS applications,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs j JOIN applications a ON a.job_id = j.id WHERE j.status IN ('interview','offer','rejected'))::int AS answered,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM documents WHERE kind = 'cover_letter')::int AS letters,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_object_agg(status, total), '{}') FROM v_pipeline) AS pipeline,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM (
     SELECT id, title, company, location, score, verdict, status, url, to_char(collected_at, 'DD/MM') AS day
     FROM jobs WHERE score IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('new','shortlisted')
     ORDER BY score DESC, collected_at DESC LIMIT 12) t) AS top_jobs,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM (
     SELECT j.id, j.title, j.company, j.status, j.score, to_char(a.applied_at, 'DD/MM') AS applied,
            (current_date - a.applied_at::date) AS days, a.followup_count
     FROM jobs j JOIN applications a ON a.job_id = j.id
     ORDER BY j.status_changed_at DESC LIMIT 60) t) AS applications_list,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM (SELECT skill, occurrences FROM v_missing_skills LIMIT 10) t) AS missing_skills,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(t ORDER BY t.bucket), '[]') FROM (
     SELECT least(score / 10, 9) * 10 AS bucket, count(*)::int AS n
     FROM jobs WHERE score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) t) AS score_histogram,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(t ORDER BY t.day), '[]') FROM (
     SELECT to_char(d, 'DD/MM') AS label, d::date AS day,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE collected_at::date = d::date)::int AS collected,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM status_history WHERE to_status = 'applied' AND changed_at::date = d::date)::int AS applied
     FROM generate_series(current_date - 13, current_date, interval '1 day') d) t) AS activity,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM (
     SELECT 'France Travail' AS kind, keywords AS name, active, last_count,
            to_char(last_run_at, 'DD/MM HH24:MI') AS last_run, NULL::text AS error FROM searches
     UNION ALL
     SELECT 'RSS', name, active, last_count, to_char(last_fetched_at, 'DD/MM HH24:MI'), last_error FROM feeds) t) AS sources,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM (
     SELECT workflow_name, node_name, message, to_char(created_at, 'DD/MM HH24:MI') AS at
     FROM workflow_errors ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5) t) AS errors;

parameters.responseBody: 🔒 Accès refusé : ajoute ?token=... à l'URL (DASHBOARD_TOKEN dans .env).
